thread:
Maria: kicking off a quick Q planning thread for Hosted API — main asks: rerank SLA, embeddings p95, and carve-out for chat latency targets
Ash: short context: 2 enterprise customers asked for an opt-in rerank SLA (99.9 uptime + 200ms p95). they want contractual guarantees for Q4.
Devin: 200ms p95 for rerank sounds unrealistic for hosted multitenant unless we change batching defaults or route to dedicated pools.
Jules: proposal: make it an opt-in feature for Dedicated + Dedicated Lite routing. that way we can guarantee isolation and tail latency.
Maria: agree on opt-in. need launch criteria and a rollback plan. also cost delta needs to be clear for sales.
Ash: suggested launch criteria (draft):
- SLA validated on Dedicated clusters for 10 business days at 80% of projected peak
- mean and p95 documented in console + public perf profile
- pricing addendum + support playbook in docs
- automated fallback to lower-cost rerank model if latency or capacity breach occurs
Devin: technical tradeoffs:
- To hit 200ms p95 we need: continuous small-batch mode OR a soft 2x increase in compute for dedicated customers
- KV cache pinning for rerank prefix would help but requires model-level caching hooks
Jules: can we gate behind a feature flag so SALES can toggle per-customer?
Samir: ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: deploy-checklist/1775558888 — includes perf tests, canary policy, chaos test for degraded GPU nodes :gear:
Maria: @Ash @Devin what's minimal scope for a beta customer?
Ash: beta scope = dedicated routing + guaranteed batch-size=1 path + guardrails: throttles and queue len alerting
Devin: add quantized fallback model path if high load. quantized model gives similar relevance for rerank in many cases.
Jules: acceptance tests (short):
- end-to-end rerank latency p95 <= 220ms during normal load (beta)
- error rate <= 0.1%
- quality regression vs baseline <= 3% on held prompt set
Maria: quality regression gate is important. who owns the eval suite?
Devin: research will own eval harness but product must own customer-specific prompt sets for post-launch monitoring.
Ash: commercial note: we should surface an "SLA Premium" flag in pricing sheet and console when toggled. also require contract amendment.
Samir: ops-bot: added monitor -> rerank_tail_latency_p95 (prod,dedicated) and alert -> pager if > 220ms for 5m :bell:
Jules: timeline idea: Q3 prototype + limited beta (2 customers) -> Q4 general availability for Dedicated only. rollout to Hosted multitenant would be later after optimization.
Maria: can we document exact rollback steps now? keep short:
- step 1: turn off SLA routing feature flag
- step 2: route affected customers to fallback model + inform SRE oncall
- step 3: open incident, collect p95 traces and KV cache hit rates
Ash: I'd add an immediate capacity burst to Dedicated pool as a temporary mitigation before rollback.
Devin: quick perf snippet to run locally (example):
```
wrk -t4 -c50 -d60s http://hosted-api/re-rank -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -s rerank_load.py
```
rerank_load.py = small-batch workload that emulates 1-token contexts + topk rerank calls.
Maria: docs needed: product doc + runbook + pricing + sales FAQ. who's taking docs?
Jules: I'll own runbook and FAQ. Ash will draft pricing language. Devin + Research will supply eval baselines.
Samir: ops-bot: scheduled canary window 2026-05-03 02:00-06:00 UTC for dedicated pool test :calendar:
Maria: final ask: add explicit success metrics to OKRs:
- one: launch beta with 2 customers and meet acceptance tests
- two: SLA adoption revenue target $Xk MRR by end of Q4
- three: regression-free for chat customers (no >5% perf regression)
Ash: noted. will draft the OKR bullets and share a PR to roadmap doc.
Devin: quick note — embedding p95 objective we discussed separately: aim for 80ms p95 for small embeddings under dedicated. we should avoid mixing that SLA with rerank SLA. keep them separate.
Maria: good call. separate features, separate contracts. thanks everyone — closing this thread. please drop short updates in #product when PRs go up. :thumbsup:
